raw.title: build(deps): bump respec from 37.2.0 to 37.3.0
raw.body:
Bumps [respec](https://github.com/speced/respec) from 37.2.0 to 37.3.0.
Release notes

Sourced from respec's releases.

v37.3.0

Features

  • feat(core/render-biblio): render pages field by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5252

Fixes

  • fix(core/highlight): use textContent so unrendered code is highlighted by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5379
  • fix(tools): await puppeteer executablePath in release preflight by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5392
  • fix(w3c/seo): HTTPS schema.org context, fix datePublished by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5248
  • fix(w3c/headers): drop stray brace from TAG finding prevVersion URL by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5380

Full Changelog: https://github.com/speced/respec/compare/v37.2.0...v37.3.0

Commits
  • 833af8f v37.3.0

  • d7cac08 feat(core/render-biblio): render pages field (#5252)
  • a9d1e64 fix(core/highlight): use textContent so unrendered code is highlighted (#5379)
  • 7be0134 chore(deps-dev): upgrade typescript to 7.0.2 (#5372)
  • 1b66b21 fix(w3c/seo): HTTPS schema.org context, fix datePublished (#5248)
  • 264a684 chore(deps): consolidate 8 dependency updates (#5387)
  • 81cdcbf fix(w3c/headers): drop stray brace from TAG finding prevVersion URL (#5380)
  • e827ef5 chore(deps-dev): upgrade eslint to 10 (#5373)
  • f68be18 chore(deps): consolidate 9 dependency updates (#5371)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
